title: REQ · Loader reports missing asset files and falls back without crashing
summary: Fallback load returns a usable manifest plus a missing-asset report
description: Context: loadManifestFile returns ok:false when any file is missing, giving callers nothing to render. Desired behavior: a new loadManifestWithFallback returns { manifest, missing, errors, fallbackAssetId } where manifest contains only assets whose files exist, missing lists absent assets, and an unreadable or invalid manifest yields an empty manifest with errors. Expected result: the game keeps running with a fallback asset id for anything missing. Why: no crash on missing art.
acceptance_criteria: Given one existing and one missing asset file, when loadManifestWithFallback runs, then manifest holds only the existing asset and missing names the other id and path.
Given a nonexistent manifest file, when it runs, then it returns an empty assets list and one error, and does not throw.
Given all files exist, when it runs, then missing is empty and the result equals the full manifest.
definition_of_done: loadManifestWithFallback exported and covered by unit tests
